fields.summary: As a store manager I want to see which products are running low
fields.description:
As a store manager I want low-stock products highlighted so that I can reorder them before they run out.

Acceptance criteria:
- A product is low on stock when stock is below its reorder level.
- Products get an optional numeric field reorderLevel; when it is missing, the default is 5.
- The API validates reorderLevel as a non-negative integer when present.
- Low-stock rows show a "Low stock" badge next to the stock number.
- The page header shows how many products are low on stock, e.g. "2 low on stock".
- Tests cover the API validation and the UI badge and count.
